examples.label: Trail above a blog post
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-breadcrumb" site="Global" id="breadcrumb-blog" size="medium"> <:item icon="hero-home" link="/" title="Home page">Home <:item link="/blog">Blog <:item link="/blog/category/engineering">Engineering <:item>Why we moved previews behind signed tokens

examples.label: Shop category trail with a slash separator
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-breadcrumb" site="Global" id="breadcrumb-shop" color="natural" separator_icon="hero-slash" separator_icon_class="opacity-40">
  <:item link="/">Home</:item>
  <:item link="/shop">Shop</:item>
  <:item link="/shop/audio">Audio</:item>
  <:item>Studio Pro X2 Headphones</:item>
</.component>

examples.label: Admin settings trail with section icons
examples.source:
